mode.title: Mode
mode.description: top = the largest positions by percent of portfolio. holdings = the entire portfolio, which for a total market fund is thousands of rows. summary = one row per fund with net assets, holding count, asset mix and largest position.

tickers.title: Fund tickers
tickers.description: ETF or mutual fund ticker symbols, e.g. VOO, QQQ, ARKK, VTI. Maximum 25 per run. Ordinary stock tickers will not resolve, since only registered funds file this report.

topN.title: Positions per fund (top mode)
topN.description: How many of the largest positions to return for each fund. The main cost lever: a total market index fund reports over 3,500 holdings.

minPercent.title: Min percent of portfolio
minPercent.description: Skip positions smaller than this share of the fund, e.g. 0.5 keeps only meaningful weights. 0 = keep everything.

assetCategory.title: Asset category
assetCategory.description: Filter to one kind of holding. Funds report equities, debt, short term investments and derivatives in the same portfolio.

userAgent.title: SEC User-Agent
userAgent.description: The SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent containing a contact email, or it returns 403. Replace the default with your own name and email.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned across all funds. Controls total cost.
